question: Does the voice correction gate validate the selected, proofread paragraph rather than rejecting the run for an unused alternative?
failure_evidence: r13 selected no second TTS because an unselected expanded Ukrainian variant contained the Russian form “густины”. The shallow surface gate checked all variants before selection and proofreading.

change.behavior: Select one complete paragraph alternative, proofread it, then apply the native-surface gate before the next TTS send.
